title: forced-reassembly buffer in pinfo->pool kept by the persistent reassembly table and compared by a later frame
live_proof: absent at the 4.6.8 pin by inspection: packet-t38.c allocates the buffer with g_malloc and ties it to the tvb with tvb_set_free_cb(fd_head->tvb_data, g_free). The pre-fix shape is quoted from 6fd3af5e99^ at packet-t38.c:358-359 and the read at reassemble.c:2064.
object: the forced-reassembly data buffer, size bytes in pinfo->pool (one byte in the reported instance)
lifetime_ender: epan_dissect_reset between packets (epan.c:602 at the fix's parent), which frees pinfo->pool while the reassembly table keeps the tvb over it
shape: packet-scope object kept by file-scope state across packets
fidelity: model-consumer, real allocator; the reassembly table is reduced to a file-scope head holding the buffer pointer, and the tvb wrapper is elided
distinguishing: the stale access is a memcmp of the stored fragment against the new one; no reoccupation is asserted, so the unprotected arm compares against the old byte
